description: This class includes the construction of motorways, streets, roads and other vehicular and pedestrian ways.
includes: construction of motorways, roads, streets, lanes and other paved surfaces
construction of bridges, including those for elevated highways
surface work on streets, roads, highways, bridges and tunnels
painting and other marking of road surfaces
installation of crash barriers, road signs and similar items
excludes: installation of public lighting systems, see 4321
